ZAMALEK BRANCH
Why Choose Us in Zamalek?
Welcome to American Vet Center in Zamalek, where Cairo pet parents trust us for expert care and a personal touch. Our modern clinic offers everything from routine check-ups and vaccinations to dental care, diagnostics, and advanced surgery. Our experienced team treats every dog, cat, and exotic pet like family, ensuring each visit is stress-free.
Call us today to schedule your pet’s appointment — we’re open 7 days a week in the heart of Zamalek.
